build: Triad crack, D64 (plain image), hand-over at $0900, trainer off

comments.text: frame counter low byte, incremented by the raster interrupt once per video frame
frame counter high byte
joystick port 1 (CIA1 port B) in the low five bits, active low, read once per frame
joystick port 2 (CIA1 port A) in the low five bits, active low, read once per frame
the firefighter's state: bit 7 set means he is not playing, 1 is hit and falling, 2 is falling, 4 to 6 and 11 are the end-of-stage sequences, 0 is normal
the firefighter's screen x position in pixels
the firefighter's height up the building, low byte (16-bit with $45)
the firefighter's height up the building, high byte
the stage being played, 1 to 16, wrapped with AND $0F after the last
$FF while the attract-mode demonstration plays the stage, 0 in a real game
set non-zero when the player presses fire during the attract loop
entry from the hand-over code at $0929: jumps over a spare byte to the main program
enables interrupts, builds the raster-interrupt engine, starts the music, then runs the attract loop forever
one pass of the attract loop: clear the screen, load the title raster list, then show the logo, title, high scores and a demo stage in turn
waits for the screen's delay; if start was pressed it falls into the start of a real game
if $C4 is clear return; otherwise discard the callers and run a real game with the score table
runs the current stage as a demonstration with the demo flag set, then moves to the next stage number
the title screen's raster list: two entries (handler address low and high, raster line, spare) at lines 2 and 49
waits up to 150 frames for the frame counter to change, returning early when start is pressed
draws the title text screen with the credits from $BEE0 onwards
copies the title screen's character data into the bitmap area and the colour data
fills the screen at $5C00-$5FFF with spaces, the colour RAM with the background colour and turns the sprites off
draws the Electric Dreams logo and the word PRESENTS
plays one stage from start to finish: sets up the world, then loops through the per-frame routines four video frames at a time
sets up a new stage: clears the object tables, copies the screen furniture, scrolls the map to the start and positions the firefighter
copies the building's tile characters for the stage's colour scheme into the character set
copies a row of the building's tile graphics into the character set
decompresses the map of the building for the stage into $0B00 onwards
scrolls the building past the window during the Get Ready screen
moves the firefighter from the joystick: climbing up and down, moving left and right and falling
clamps the firefighter's position, works out the scrolling window and picks the map cells around him
picks the left-moving animation frame for the firefighter's sprite
looks up the type of the map cell at the offset in Y and returns its collision class
picks the right-moving animation frame
picks the climbing animation frame
advances the animation frame counter, wrapping at the limit in A
the end-of-stage sequence: the firefighter reaches the top, the rescue and the fall to the ground
the firefighter is hit by fire: starts the falling and loses a life
draws the high-score table and the TODAY'S BEST FIREFIGHTERS heading
moves each of the six water-spray shots and tests them against the building
starts a spray shot in a free slot, at most two of the same direction
tests a spray shot against a rectangle and removes it on a hit

moves each of five objects held at $0A96 along a direction table, removes them at the edge of the building and calls the hit routine when one touches the firefighter; what they look like on the screen is not yet checked
starts a new fire in a randomly chosen window every few frames
grows each burning window fire and lets it spawn falling debris
starts a falling piece of debris from a burning window
moves each of three falling pieces of debris held at $09A4, hands each to the sprite list and calls the hit routine when one touches the firefighter
when a spray shot reaches a burning window it puts the fire out, scores a point total and removes the shot
tests every debris piece against the spray shot and removes the debris it touches
tests the floating object at $CA-$CD against the spray shot
sets up the raster-interrupt engine and the interrupt and NMI vectors
waits for the raster position to pass line 256
empty non-maskable interrupt handler that clears the CIA2 interrupt flag
raster interrupt entry: acknowledges the interrupt and jumps through the address held at $2942, set by the raster list
common tail of each raster handler: advances the list, flips the double buffer, counts frames, reads the joysticks and the keyboard, calls the music at $FFAA and sets the next raster line
copies a 128-byte raster list from the address in X (high) and Y (low) into the list buffer not being used, then waits for it to be taken
the in-game raster list: handlers at lines 20, 92, 124, 155, 212 and 230
